symbols.name: DiscountResult
symbols.signature: interface DiscountResult { amount: number; applied: PromoCode; }

symbols.name: applyPromo
symbols.signature: function applyPromo(code: PromoCode, subtotal: number): number { switch (code) { case "SAVE10": return round(subtotal * 0.1); case "WELCOME5": return round(subtotal * 0.05); case "FREESHIP": return 0; } }

symbols.name: applyPromoToCart
symbols.signature: function applyPromoToCart( cart: Cart, code: PromoCode, ): DiscountResult { const subtotal = cart.lines.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.quantity, 0); return { amount: applyPromo(code, subtotal), applied: code }; }

symbols.name: round
symbols.signature: function round(value: number): number { return Math.round(value * 100) / 100; }
